title: Image deletion and recovery policy decision
purpose: Document the two competing requests for the outcome of an owner selecting Delete on an uploaded image, and record what remains undecided.

scope.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

requirements.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

stories.text: If a human selects the immediate permanent deletion policy, an image owner can select Delete on an uploaded image and have it permanently deleted immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion policy, when the owner of an uploaded image selects Delete, then that image is permanently deleted immediately.
Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion policy, when the owner of an uploaded image selects Delete, then the owner cannot recover that image afterwards.

stories.text: If a human selects the 30-day recoverability policy, an image owner can select Delete on an uploaded image and remain able to recover it for 30 days afterwards.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the 30-day recoverability policy, when the owner of an uploaded image selects Delete, then the owner remains able to recover that image for 30 days after Delete.

dependencies.text: No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.

risks.text: Satisfying the immediate permanent deletion request would leave the 30-day recovery request unmet, and satisfying the 30-day recovery request would leave the immediate permanent deletion request unmet.

open_questions: Which policy should a human select for the outcome of an owner selecting Delete on an uploaded image: immediate permanent deletion, or owner recoverability for 30 days after Delete?
Who has authority to select between the immediate permanent deletion request and the 30-day recoverability request?
